name: Regina A.
headline: Senior Director at Oracle | Executive Leader | Consulting, Managed Services & Global Operations | Business Transformation
location: Metro Manila, National Capital Region, Philippines
about:
A 25-year++ career defined by the strategic intersection of ERP implementation, B2B Cloud Services, and large-scale Offshore Delivery operations. Expert at steering high-stakes portfolios where operational scale meets "World Class" precision.

 Core Impact & Portfolio Performance:

 Elite Delivery Standards: Leading a NetSuite implementation engine that consistently achieves an NPS of 78 —surpassing the SaaS industry average of 30 and exceeding the "World Class" benchmark of 50+.

 Revenue & Portfolio Velocity: Oversight of 700+ concurrent full-cycle ERP projects, consistently outperforming financial targets with a achievement range of 103% to 109%.

 ARR Activation: Proven track record of turning on an average of USD 83M in ARR per quarter, with high-water marks reaching in a fiscal quarter, USD 130M worth of ARR .

 Global Workforce Mobilization: Through 25+ years of experience, collectively led 1,500+ FTEs across multi-lingual, multi geo (incl PH, HK JP, IN), 24/7 environments, resulting in a robust install base of public customer testimonials and proven delivery excellence.

 Strategic Competencies:
 
Technological Integration: AI-certified approach to modernizing consulting workflows and operational efficiency.

 Performance Excellence: Certified Six Sigma Yellow Belt methodology applied to complex project lifecycles.

 Human Capital Development: Certified Professional Career and Leadership Coach dedicated to building high-performing global delivery teams.
